# NoInlineComponents inlines user components into the app root. It used to look
# for a `component main` and give up when there was none — but a program that
# declares its windows at top level has no main, so every component stayed
# un-inlined for that whole form. Platforms that rely on the pass then met IR
# they do not handle: fyne panicked in irwalk on the ir.SlotInst that survived.
#
# The root is main *or* the windows, so both forms inline. A package with
# neither is left alone: every component there is its own entry point, so
# nothing is unreachable and dropping them would empty the program.

# A slot under a top-level window — the shape that panicked.
sngl generate --out anon anon.sngl
grep 'alpha' anon/model.go
grep 'inner' anon/model.go

# No main and no windows: the component is the entry point and must survive.
sngl generate --out lone lone.sngl
grep 'standalone' lone/model.go

-- anon.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

struct Row {
    title string
}

component table(rows list<Row>, slot _) {
    vbox {
        for var r = rows {
            text(value=r.title)
        }
        slot
    }
}

window #w(href="/index.html", title="x") {
    table(rows=[Row{title = "alpha"}]) {
        text(value="inner")
    }
}

output { go { fyne } }
-- lone.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component standalone {
    vbox {
        text(value="standalone")
    }
}

output { go { fyne } }
